import subprocess,json
p=subprocess.run(["uv","run","--frozen","pytest","-o","addopts=","--collect-only","-q"],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
nodes=[line for line in p.stdout.splitlines() if "::" in line]
print(json.dumps({"collected":len(nodes),"around_first_failure":[{"index":i,"node":nodes[i]} for i in range(199,214)]}))
